description: This file is a PHP unit test class for the I18NTranslationAPI component. It contains tests for retrieving all translations and placeholder tests for creating and deleting translations, primarily verifying API behavior and exception handling.

classes.name: I18NTranslationAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the I18NTranslationAPI, testing retrieval of translation entries and handling of unimplemented methods such as create and delete.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the API's capability to fetch all translation entries using a provided data provider for different test cases.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for the 'testGetAll' method from a specified YAML dataset.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests that invoking the create method on the API raises a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Tests that the validation rule retrieval for creation raises a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests that invoking the delete method on the API raises a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Tests that the validation rule retrieval for delete raises a not implemented exception.
